versions.changelog: Pick of the day and track record features

- Initial release of EdgeBets skill.
- Provides AI-powered sports betting simulations using Monte Carlo analysis.
- Supports NBA, NFL, MLB, and MLS games for predictions and analysis.
- Features include win probabilities, projected scores, spread predictions, and edge/value detection.
- Allows browsing today's games (free), running in-depth simulations (paid), and checking USDC balance.
- Integration with Solana for payments and secure transactions.
